texts:
Friday's final injury reports are in. Eleven fantasy players are out for Week 4, nobody is doubtful and eight are questionable.

Jadarian Price is out for Seattle. Emanuel Wilson moves up to RB31 for me, a low-end RB3.

Every team, every pivot. Let's dive in.
#Seahawks

Jadarian Price reinjured the chest, and Zach Charbonnet is Week 5 at the earliest.

Emanuel Wilson ran 21 times for 92 yards in Week 2 when Price left. RB31 for me.

George Holani caught 5 of 5 in Week 3. RB40, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#Seahawks #BoltUp

Justin Jefferson (ankle) is out. Pivot to Jordan Addison, WR25 for me, a high-end WR3.

Jaylen Wright practiced in full and is listed first on Miami's depth chart at MIN. Stash him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Ollie Gordon II is RB35 for me; sit him.
#Skol #PhinsUp

Philadelphia is without three pass catchers vs LAR.

DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is out, two to three games expected. Pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR32 for me, a low-end WR3.

Hollywood Brown (ankle) is out too. Wicks ran 81 percent of the routes at CHI.
#FlyEaglesFly #RamsHouse

Dallas Goedert (knee) is out with the sprained MCL, so Mundt and Ertz split the tight end snaps. Pivot to Juwan Johnson, TE8 for me.

Saquon Barkley picks up targets with all three out. RB15 for me this week, an RB2.
#FlyEaglesFly #Saints

Breece Hall (quad) is out at CHI after three missed practices.

Braelon Allen played every snap after Hall left at DET. Pivot to Allen, RB20 for me this week, an RB2.

Isaiah Davis has no offensive snap this season; leave him on waivers.
#JetUp #DaBears

Mason Taylor (thumb) is out a second straight week.

Adonai Mitchell (finger) is out.

Kenyon Sadiq (back) was limited all week. TE14 for me, a borderline start if active; inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Garrett Wilson is WR6 for me.
#JetUp

Caleb Williams (hamstring) is out three to four weeks, and the backup starts vs NYJ.

D'Andre Swift missed Thursday, practiced in full Friday and has no designation. RB17 for me this week, an RB2.

Colston Loveland is TE15 for me, a streamer.
#DaBears #JetUp

Washington plays IND in London at 9:30 AM ET.

Jayden Daniels (elbow) is out. Pivot to Marcus Mariota, QB17 for me, a streamer. He threw 3 touchdowns vs SEA.

Rachaad White (shoulder) is out. Jacory Croskey-Merritt is RB24 for me, an RB2.
#RaiseHail #ForTheShoe

Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is a new Friday listing, limited after two full days. WR41 for me if active, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Stefon Diggs is WR27 for me, a high-end WR3, and the next man up.

London inactives drop at 8:00 AM ET.
#RaiseHail

Keenan Allen (groin) missed Friday after two limited days. WR36 for me, a low-end WR3 if active. Have a 1 PM receiver ready.

Josh Downs is first in line if he sits. WR15 for me this week, a WR2.

Tyler Warren is TE4 for me.
#ForTheShoe

Ladd McConkey (foot) was limited Friday but did not run routes in the open portion. WR40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Omarion Hampton is RB27 for me, a high-end RB3, in a three-back rotation.
#BoltUp #Seahawks

Mike Evans (ribs) missed all three practices with side work Friday. Outside my top 50 receivers, a dart throw at best; sit him.

George Kittle drew 7 of 27 targets after Evans got hurt. TE3 for me.

Christian McCaffrey is RB4 for me.
#FTTB #BroncosCountry

Denver's third back, Jonah Coleman, is on IR with a high ankle until Week 7 at the earliest.

J.K. Dobbins kept 17 of the backs' 20 carries in Week 3. RB32 for me, a low-end RB3.

RJ Harvey kept the routes. RB30 for me, a high-end RB3.
#BroncosCountry #FTTB

Nico Collins practiced in full Friday and has no designation vs DAL in his first game back from the hamstring. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.

C.J. Stroud is QB12 for me, a borderline start this week.
#HTownMade #DallasCowboys

DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited all week but has no designation vs NE. WR23 for me this week, a WR2.

A.J. Brown's earliest return is Week 6.

Drake Maye is QB18 for me, outside my top 12; sit him.
#BillsMafia #NEPats

Tyjae Spears (ankle) practiced in full Friday and should play. RB39 for me behind Tony Pollard, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; sit him.

Pollard has no designation and 80 percent of the early downs. RB29 for me, a high-end RB3.
#TitanUp #RavensFlock

Baltimore lost both centers, so rookie Vega Ioane plays center vs TEN.

Lamar Jackson practiced in full Thursday and has no designation. QB2 for me.

Zay Flowers (hamstring) is questionable after a rest day Friday. WR9 for me.

Derrick Henry is RB6 for me.
#RavensFlock

Bucky Irving (glute) practiced in full Friday, no designation. RB19 for me this week, an RB2.

Chris Godwin is back at practice but fell to 62 percent of the snaps in Week 3. A dart throw for me.

Christian Watson is off the injury report. WR10 for me.
#GoBucs #GoPackGo

Jalen Coker (quad) was limited Thursday and Friday; inactives at 6:50 PM ET Sunday night. Outside my top 50 receivers even if he plays; sit him.

If Coker sits, stream Darren Waller vs DET. TE18 for me; he led Carolina with 8 targets in Week 3.
#KeepPounding #OnePride

Jack Bech (forearm) is on IR for Las Vegas.

Brock Bowers drew 13 of 30 targets in his first game back. TE1 for me.

Kansas City left tackle Josh Simmons missed Wednesday with the back. Rashee Rice is WR17 for me this week, a WR2.
#RaiderNation #ChiefsKingdom

Cincinnati ruled out Colbie Young (knee) vs JAX.

Andrei Iosivas is on IR with the thumb.

Ja'Marr Chase is WR3 for me.

Jakobi Meyers (thumb) cleared the injury report. WR31 for me, a low-end WR3.
#WhoDey #DUUUVAL

James Conner is on IR until Week 5 at the earliest.

Jeremiyah Love played 64 percent of Arizona's snaps in Week 3, his first time leading the backfield. RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week @NYG.

Cam Skattebo is RB16 for me this week, an RB2.
#BirdGang #NYGiants

Monday night, Travis Etienne Jr. is on IR with the hamstring. Alvin Kamara is RB25 for me, a high-end RB3.

Jordyn Tyson is not expected to practice next week.

Drake London is WR7 for me with Michael Penix Jr. starting.
#Saints #DirtyBirds

Every designation, practice report and pivot is in Prep Notes on the site, and the Menu is refreshed.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/prep.html?week=4
